articles.title: The White House is asking OpenAI to slow roll the release of its new model over safety concerns
articles.summary: OpenAI reportedly plans to share its newest model, GPT 5.6, with a select group of partners instead of with the broader public. The reason: the Trump administration told it to.
articles.author: Lucas Ropek

articles.title: Patronus AI lands $50M to build ‘digital worlds’ that stress-test AI agents
articles.summary: Agent-testing startup Patronus AI, founded by former Meta AI researchers, is experiencing nearly insatiable demand, its investor says.
articles.author: Marina Temkin

articles.title: Polymarket says hackers stole users’ funds
articles.summary: The prediction market giant Polymarket said it's refunding users who had funds stolen due to a third-party breach.
articles.author: Lorenzo Franceschi-Bicchierai

articles.title: Notion Mail shuts down amid agent takeover
articles.summary: The company said it is discontinuing its email inbox in favor of its AI agent offering as users are increasingly handing over the reins of their email to the agents.
articles.author: Ivan Mehta

articles.title: Anthropic’s Claude is winning over paid consumers, a market owned by ChatGPT
articles.summary: Despite ChatGPT's commanding market lead, consumers who pay for AI have been increasingly choosing Anthropic's Claude, data shows.
articles.author: Julie Bort

articles.title: General Intuition’s $2.3B bet that video games can train AI agents for the real world
articles.summary: General Intuition has raised $320 million to scale AI trained on millions of hours of gameplay, betting action data can help AI develop something closer to human intuition.
articles.author: Rebecca Bellan

articles.title: Databricks’ former AI chief thinks he can cut AI’s power bill by 1,000x
articles.summary: Un-0 is an image-generation system tool that shows for the first time how the company's technology can replicate conventional AI systems.
articles.author: Russell Brandom

articles.title: Google Finance gets a dedicated app for Android
articles.summary: Users will be able to access their watchlists, real-time market data, live financial news, and Google's AI-powered "Key Moments" feature, which explains why stocks moved.
articles.author: Aisha Malik

articles.title: Netris raises $15M Series A from a16z to help AI neoclouds go live faster
articles.summary: Netris provides software that runs on network switches, and offers a platform that helps neocloud operators reduce the time it takes to go live.
articles.author: Ram Iyer

articles.title: Amazon ups India bet with fresh $13B AI infrastructure investment
articles.summary: Amazon’s latest India investment comes as global tech companies race to expand AI infrastructure in the country.
articles.author: Jagmeet Singh
